notes: Starter grounding gold slice (clean_document modality). Target is 50-100 labeled cases; expand per docs/07-qa/GROUNDING_GOLD_SLICE.md before flipping the hard gate. Check A runs for real; expected_deterministic is anchored to grounding.verify_evidence. expected_entailment is the human label; stub_entailment (optional) simulates a verifier prediction for the CI metric harness.
